envelope.description: Define the sc5 review details, validators and pure mappings

body.title: Define the sc5 review details, validators and pure mappings
body.summary: In a new module src/daemon/task-progress/review-measurements.ts define DesignReviewDetails and CodeReviewDetails exactly as sc5, in this order: bounded typebox validators and a combined validateReviewDetails(kind, value); then the design mapping from a ReviewWorkerProgress to a DelegateMeasurement (phase, active chunk, reviewed against selected chunks as unit 'chunks', retained chunks, retries null); then the code mapping (phase, active task name, completed against total tasks as unit 'tasks', followUp and retries null, publication pending | complete | failed | unknown). Mappings return null for foreign identity, completed above total, a retained plus selected total that is not the planned total, or unverified admission claiming reviewed work. Each part has its own tests.
acceptanceChecks: validators accept the sc5 shapes and reject unknown kinds, extra fields, negative or non-integer counts and over-long labels
design mapping keeps retained coverage out of the fresh counts and reports retries null
code mapping reports initial tasks, publication state and followUp and retries null
inconsistent counts, foreign identity and unverified admission with reviewed work map to null
a mapped measurement fits the 8 KiB snapshot bound
